commanders.name: Achilles

skills.name: Pelian Spear
skills.effect: Launches 2 combo attacks against up to 5 nearby enemy troops (Damage Factor 1000, every additional target reduces the damage to each target by 15%). The targets lose 20% March Speed for 3 seconds. The targets are also inflicted with Sundered for 10 seconds, increasing the damage they receive from Pelian Spear by 5%. This effect can stack up to 3 times, its duration resets whenever it gains another stack, and it does not automatically clear when exiting combat.

skills.effect_source: testo di gioco livello max (app.rokstats.online, game version 1.1.12.20)

commanders.notes: Disponibile nei regni aperti da piu' di 120 giorni (search snippet); theriagames: ottenibile via Mightiest Governor (giorno 233), sculture universali, evento Card King. Livelli 1-5 completi dai dati di gioco (rokstats, 2026-09-28). 690 sculture per portare al massimo le 4 skill di un Legendary (piu' 10 per sbloccarlo = 700 totali); costo generico per tutti i Legendary, non specifico del comandante.

talent_builds.stat_summary: Massimo danno da skill e rabbia.
talent_builds.notes: AllClash build 1 (raccomandato, 'Skill build'): Rejuvenate per primo, poi Full Quiver e Razor Sharp nell'Archer, ultimi punti in Heraldic Shield e Tactical Mastery. L'albero Versatility non si usa. RKG 'PVP Archer build': nuke, rabbia, statistiche.

talent_builds.stat_summary: Meno rabbia, piu' sopravvivenza e velocita' di marcia.
talent_builds.notes: AllClash build 2 'Archery build' alternativo. Talenti Archer aggiuntivi da hokbuild (Arrows Nocked, Thumb Ring, Venomous Sting).

NB: la pagina RKG riporta nei punti di forza '1.500 damage factor su 5 bersagli', che e' la skill di Nebuchadnezzar (errore di copia nella fonte).

skills.name: Spear of the Empire

skills.name: Shield of Eagles
skills.effect: This commander's infantry units gain 15% Attack. If this commander is serving as a garrison commander, infantry units in the garrison gain 15% Defense and 15% Health.
skills.effect_source: rokstats (testo di gioco, livello 5)

skills.name: Defense of Gaul
skills.effect: This commander's troop deals 20% more counterattack damage. If this commander is serving as a garrison commander, whenever the garrison launches a basic attack it inflicts 1 stack of the following debuff on the target: the target takes 1% more damage from infantry units for 15 seconds. This debuff can stack up to 10 times, and its duration resets whenever it gains another stack. Cooldown: 10 seconds.
skills.effect_source: rokstats (testo di gioco, livello 5)

skills.name: Victory at Chalons
skills.effect: This commander's troop deals 10% more damage. Whenever their troop launches a basic attack against a target that is currently taking additional damage over time, it has a 100% chance to Silence the target for 2 seconds. Cooldown: 7 seconds.
skills.effect_source: rokstats (testo di gioco, livello 5)

skills.name: Song of the Nibelungs
skills.effect: This commander's troop takes 10% less normal damage. Whenever their troop uses an active skill, it has a 30% chance to inflict 2 stacks of the following debuff on the target: the target takes 1% more damage from infantry units for 15 seconds. This debuff can stack up to 10 times, its duration resets whenever it gains another stack, and it can stack with the effect of the Defense of Gaul skill. Cooldown: 10 seconds.
skills.effect_source: rokstats (testo di gioco, expertise)

skills.name: Co-Ruler

skills.name: Royal Power
skills.effect: If this commander is serving as a garrison commander, whenever the garrison is hit with a basic attack it has a 10% chance to gain a 40% bonus to damage dealt for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 5 seconds.

skills.name: Honor to the Last

Pairing ufficiale in-game 'Boudica Damage' (Archers, Field, Season of Conquest): Boudica's Revenge of the Iceni increases the target's skill damage received, whereas Yi Seong-Gye's Destiny increases his troop's skill damage dealt. That's a whole lot of skill damage!
Pairing ufficiale in-game 'Cyrus the Great Damage' (Archers, Field, Season 2): The skill damage bump from Yi Seong-Gye's Destiny enhances all the additional damage dealt by Cyrus the Great.

skills.effect: Deals direct damage to up to 5 nearby enemy troops (Damage Factor 2000; every additional target reduces the damage to each target by 15%). Troops hit by this skill deal 15% less damage for 3 seconds.
skills.effect_source: rokstats (testo di gioco, livello 5)

skills.name: Borrowing Arrows
skills.effect: This commander's archer units gain 30% Health and deal 5% more damage. If their troop is on the map, whenever it is inflicted with a control effect it has a 50% chance to negate the effect and deal direct damage to the troop that inflicted it (Damage Factor 500). Cooldown: 5 seconds.
skills.effect_source: rokstats (testo di gioco, livello 5)

skills.name: Longzhong Plan
skills.effect: If this commander's troop contains only archer units, it deals 20% more skill damage. Whenever their troop launches a basic attack, the archer units in their troop have a 10% chance to gain 50% Attack for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 5 seconds.
skills.effect_source: rokstats (testo di gioco, livello 5)

skills.name: Marquis Zhongwu
skills.effect: When the secondary commander of this commander's troop uses their active skill: - If their troop does not already have the Marquis effect, it gains the Marquis effect for 10 seconds (increases damage dealt by 10%). - If their troop already has the Marquis effect and contains only archer units, it will dispel the Marquis effect and deal direct damage to up to 3 nearby enemy troops (Damage Factor 1500; not affected by skill damage buffs).
skills.effect_source: rokstats (testo di gioco, livello 5)

skills.name: Chu Shi Biao
skills.effect: Upon entering combat, this commander's troop gains the Marquis effect (increases damage dealt by 10%) for 15 seconds. Whenever they deal skill damage with the Burning of Xinye or Marquis Zhongwu skills, their troop gains 30 Rage.
skills.effect_source: rokstats (testo di gioco, expertise)

talent_builds.stat_summary: Massima generazione di rabbia per ciclare Burning of Xinye; poi buff arcieri e danno.
talent_builds.notes: AllClash: sbloccare Rejuvenate per primo, poi Feral Nature, poi Venomous Sting nell'albero Archer; punti restanti in Full Quiver e Razor Sharp. RKG: albero Archer primario, Skill secondario.

talent_builds.stat_summary: Piu' danno per colpo.
talent_builds.notes: AllClash: nel build rally dare priorita' a Razor Sharp invece di Feral Nature.

pairings.note: RKG: coppia migliore. AllClash: Boudica Prime secondaria; 'batte senza sforzo' le coppie cavalleria Nevsky+Joan Prime.

official_pairings.description: Prime Hermann supplements Zhuge Liang's lack of March Speed bonuses. In addition, his Alpha Wolf and Poison effects greatly boost the damage of Burning of Xinye and Marquis Zhongwu.
Philip II's Vergina Sun skill already makes him a great fit with most commanders, and the damage reduction from his Macedonian Phalanx greatly improves Zhuge Liang's survivability.

Zhuge Liang and Yi Seong-Gye can deal a ton of AoE skill damage, but do be aware that neither have any March Speed buffs. Positioning and timing will be key if you want to get the most use out of them.

Ashurbanipal's Hawk-Eyed more than makes up for Zhuge Liang's lack of March Speed buffs. Combine the duo with Wedge formation to enhance the AoE skill damage of From the Nile to the Tigris, Burning of Xinye, and Marquis Zhongwu.
Zhuge Liang's Chu Shi Biao helps his troop maintain a healthy supply of Rage, fueling the constant Rage expenditure of Qin Shi Huang's Iron Pierces Bronze and Seal Governs All.
